title: PC Gore Confirms: July Call Was Dismissed Unheard
description: PC Gore formally confirmed that the matter would be filed with no further action. In his 25 July 2024 message, he stated: 'No offence is identified… she’s not even going to get a knock at the door.' This shows that Sussex Police dismissed the safeguarding complaint before ever reviewing the key July Call evidence — the very same recording later labelled 'central to the investigation' in 2025.
category: Safeguarding Failure → Evidence Ignored → Premature Dismissal
public_summary: On 25 July 2024, Sussex Police confirmed they had already closed the case without reviewing the July safeguarding call. The same call would later be requested again — then excluded. This is institutional gaslighting documented in writing.
